remarks: Enjoy easy, FIRST FLOOR living right in the heart of downtown Darien. Tucked into one of the most private corners of the complex, this home has been thoughtfully updated to blend style and function.The open floor plan includes a kitchen with dedicated dining area, a spacious living room with wood wood-burning fireplace, a covered balcony, and a primary suite with ample storage. The kitchen includes custom Shaker-style cabinets, twin Sub-Zero under-counter fridge and freezer units, and an expanded opening with a teak countertop that connects to the living room. The powder room and primary bath both feature high-end Bantam tiles, custom vanities, and upgraded fixtures. The primary bath also includes a frameless glass walk-in shower and convenient access to the washer and dryer. The unit offers plenty of storage, a detached one-car garage, guest parking, and access to a beautiful pool and clubhouse. Best of all, you're just steps from all that downtown Darien has to offer... new shops, great restaurants, and easy train access to NYC and more to come!
